normalization: The Internet Archive's own text layer (_djvu.txt), held under text/ exactly as served, byte for byte: the file's SHA-256 in MANIFEST.sha256 is the hash of the served file, checked against the fetch log. It is held once (the form of EA-CORPORA-39). No text was corrected by hand; the loci keep the scan's readings. The scans are held by reference at their Archive URLs.
scope: Every Classical Philology item the Archive holds as Early Journal Content dated 1906–1922: 821 items (the advanced-search listing returned 922 rows, with duplicates; every distinct identifier is seated). 1923–1928, public domain in the United States since 2024, is not in the Early Journal Content and is pointed to.
why_seated: The census of Classical Philology (40/16; notebook §1) is coded from titles, because Crossref holds no abstracts for the journal. Seated whole, the early volumes let the census read the text question on the page at each grain, locus, work and corpus, as #1773 §4.12g read the Archiv.
held_out: Classical Philology 1923–1928: in the United States public domain, not in JSTOR's Early Journal Content at the Archive; to be sought in another scan.
